homepageFaqsEn.question: What does BAB International Corp offer?
homepageFaqsEn.answer: BAB delivers seamless connectivity and intelligent solutions including omnichannel engagement, AI, voice bots, and industry contact-center platforms across Saudi Arabia and the region.

homepageFaqsEn.question: What contact-center and omnichannel solutions does BAB provide?
homepageFaqsEn.answer: BAB helps enterprises unify customer journeys across voice, digital, and social channels, with contact-center platforms, live engagement, and omnichannel orchestration designed for Saudi and regional operations.

homepageFaqsEn.question: Does BAB offer voice bots and AI for customer service?
homepageFaqsEn.answer: Yes. BAB provides AI solutions and voice bots that support assisted and automated customer service, helping teams contain routine inquiries and improve response quality.

homepageFaqsEn.question: Why choose a Saudi connectivity and CX partner?
homepageFaqsEn.answer: BAB is based in Riyadh and focuses on local delivery for enterprises that need contact-center, omnichannel, and intelligent service platforms aligned with Saudi and MENA market needs.

homepageFaqsEn.question: Where is BAB located?
homepageFaqsEn.answer: BAB is based in Al-Yasmin, King Abdulaziz Rd, Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

homepageFaqsEn.question: How can I contact BAB?
homepageFaqsEn.answer: Email info@bab.com.sa or call +966 11 512 1440. Business hours are Sunday–Thursday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM.

homepageFaqsAr.question: ماذا تقدم شركة باب الدولية؟
homepageFaqsAr.answer: تقدم باب حلول اتصال سلسة وذكية تشمل التفاعل متعدد القنوات والذكاء الاصطناعي والروبوتات الصوتية ومنصات مراكز الاتصال في المملكة والمنطقة.

homepageFaqsAr.question: ما حلول مراكز الاتصال والقنوات المتعددة التي تقدمها باب؟
homepageFaqsAr.answer: تساعد باب المؤسسات على توحيد رحلات العملاء عبر الصوت والرقمي ووسائل التواصل، عبر منصات مراكز اتصال وتفاعل مباشر وتنسيق متعدد القنوات مصممة لعمليات السعودية والمنطقة.

homepageFaqsAr.question: هل تقدم باب روبوتات صوتية وذكاء اصطناعي لخدمة العملاء؟
homepageFaqsAr.answer: نعم. توفر باب حلول ذكاء اصطناعي وروبوتات صوتية تدعم الخدمة الآلية والمدعومة، مما يساعد الفرق على احتواء الاستفسارات الروتينية وتحسين جودة الاستجابة.

homepageFaqsAr.question: لماذا تختار شريكاً سعودياً للاتصال وتجربة العملاء؟
homepageFaqsAr.answer: باب مقرها الرياض وتركّز على التنفيذ المحلي للمؤسسات التي تحتاج منصات مراكز اتصال وقنوات متعددة وخدمة ذكية متوافقة مع احتياجات السوق السعودي ومنطقة الشرق الأوسط وشمال أفريقيا.

homepageFaqsAr.question: أين تقع باب؟
homepageFaqsAr.answer: تقع باب في الياسمين، طريق الملك عبدالعزيز، الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية.

homepageFaqsAr.question: كيف أتواصل مع باب؟
homepageFaqsAr.answer: راسل info@bab.com.sa أو اتصل على +966 11 512 1440. ساعات العمل الأحد–الخميس ٨:٠٠ ص–٥:٠٠ م.

geo.title: GEO — AI visibility
geo.description: GEO helps ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Claude, Perplexity, DeepSeek, and other AI platforms find and describe BAB as a Saudi connectivity and intelligent solutions company. Files update when you save Site Settings and Content.
geo.allOk: All {count} GEO crawler files are online. AI tools can read your public summary pages.
geo.partialOk: {ok}/{total} crawler files OK. Recheck failed rows or ensure the site is running.
geo.shouldShowOk: Should all show OK when the site is live.
geo.roleBody: FAQ, SEO, and Content Library feed GEO automatically
geo.indexNowBody: Push the sitemap to Bing (and partners). Same action as npm run seo:submit-indexnow. Covers Bing, Yandex, Seznam, and Naver — not Google.
geo.keyMissing: Not configured — save your IndexNow API key below
geo.indexNowKeyPlaceholder: Paste key from Bing Webmaster Tools
geo.indexNowKeySaved: IndexNow key saved. Key file is live at the URL below.
geo.bingHelp: For Bing IndexNow (if GEO shows Bing 403 while Yandex OK): open Bing Webmaster Tools → confirm the site is Verified → URL Submission → IndexNow → Generate API key → run npm run seo:rotate-indexnow-key — then deploy and retry Submit.
geo.bingSiteAuthHelp: For Bing site verification: set BING_SITE_AUTH_CODE in env (the <user> code from Bing Webmaster Tools → Verify → XML file or Meta tag), rebuild frontend, then confirm BingSiteAuth.xml shows OK above and click Verify in Bing.
geo.googleSiteAuthHelp: For Google Search Console: set GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION=googled43fdb9897d9f8a7 in env (filename without .html), rebuild frontend, confirm googled43fdb9897d9f8a7.html shows OK above, then click Verify in Search Console. Submit sitemap.xml under Sitemaps.
geo.googleHelp: For Google: open Search Console → Sitemaps → submit sitemap.xml, then URL Inspection → Request indexing for the priority URLs below. Gemini uses Google Search — IndexNow does not notify Google.
geo.bingUrlsBody: Submit sitemap.xml once in Bing Webmaster Tools (Sitemaps), then use Submit sitemap (IndexNow) above to push all URLs. Or copy the full list below.
geo.urlsCopyFailed: Could not copy — select and copy manually.
geo.urlsBody: Paste these in Google Search Console → URL Inspection. IndexNow already uses the same lists.
geo.whatIsBody: Simple explanation — no extra setup required
geo.seoPoint: SEO — Google and normal search engines
geo.geoPoint: GEO — AI chatbots and AI search (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Claude, Perplexity, DeepSeek, and more)
geo.how1: You update FAQ, SEO, and content in this dashboard
geo.how2: The website publishes plain-text files for AI bots
geo.how3: Over days or weeks, AI may mention BAB in answers
geo.crawlerSectionBody: Open each link in a new tab — you should see plain text, not an error page
geo.purposeLlms: Short summary about BAB for AI tools

geo.tip1: Keep the website online on your real domain (not localhost only)
